summary: Smith & Nephew PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a TR-1 notification that activist investor Cevian Capital II GP Limited crossed the 13% threshold, increasing its voting rights to 13.056% (110,517,469 shares) from 12.236% as of June 23, 2026. The indirect holdings are via Cevian Capital II Master Fund L.P. (11.87%) and Co-Investment Series P L.P. (1.19%), with Aurora Nominees as nominee and UBS as custodian. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing signals rising activist pressure on the UK orthopedic-device company. Watch for potential strategic review, board changes, or M&A push by Cevian.
